items.title: Welcome to Habari Pulse
items.summary: Your private Kenyan news and jobs feed is ready. Run the scraper to replace these sample items with live stories.
items.text: Habari Pulse is an installable Progressive Web App that keeps full articles offline. Like or dislike stories on your phone and the ranking updates for you. The scraper runs every few hours and writes data/feed.json so the app stays fast.

items.title: How to install on your phone
items.summary: Open the GitHub Pages link, then use Add to Home Screen from the browser menu.
items.text: Once the Actions workflow has run at least once you will see real headlines. Keep the repo private if you prefer. View original always links back to the publisher.
